web.name: Pick
web.description: Ride sharing in Ghana and Germany: share a commuter's empty seats or take a go-anywhere driver.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Pick uses your location to find rides near you and, for drivers, to share where you are with your passengers.

plugins.cameraPermission: Pick uses the camera so drivers can photograph their licence, insurance and car.
plugins.photosPermission: Pick lets drivers choose photos of their documents.
